title: MutateActorPrimitive
description: Mutates personal physiological or psychological attributes on an operative (e.g. fatigue, stress, loyalty).

step_id.description: Unique identifier for this pipeline step.

actor.description: Operative token or slot ID to mutate (e.g. ORDER_ACTOR, INITIATOR, crew_0).

metric.description: Target attribute key on the staff record (e.g. fatigue, stress, intoxication, loyalty).

delta.description: Numeric delta or dynamic parameter symbol to add to the attribute.

error_code.description: Failure code if mutation fails or actor cannot be resolved.

next_step.description: ID of next step on completion, or null to terminate pipeline.
